title: predicatory-comparison
description: The family of operations that compare predication-valued structures in the native value language of the theory, without first quotienting them to Boolean equality. Generated within the predicate category to ask what agrees, what diverges, what would make two structures compatible, and what changed.

operation.description: an operation-family comparing predication-valued structures rather than reducing them to a Boolean same/different bit

comparands.description: the predication-valued structures (settlings, valuations, operators, or frameworks) being compared

comparisonTyping.description: keeps the comparison typed by the structure compared: knowledge-order containment, truth-order strength, evidence merge, locus of exact agreement, or missing-evidence profile

noBooleanQuotient.description: the comparison is not first collapsed to Boolean equality; equality reappears only structurally, as in commutative diagrams and equalizers

context.description: the comparison context under which the same inputs may determine different outputs

standard.description: the comparison standard fixing what counts as agreement for these inputs

witness.description: the structured comparison witness produced as the result, not a bare same/different bit
